passages: Agents4Science received 315 submissions, and 62 submissions were incomplete and therefore desk- rejected. The remaining 253 complete submissions were reviewed by three different LLM re[viewers]
The programme committee accepted 48 papers, considering both the LLM and human reviews.
All 48 accepted papers had an AI model listed as the first author.
We estimate that approximately 44% of submissions have no hallucinated references (111 papers)
an LLM reviewer caught a numerical discrepancy in the manuscript
use: Neighbour. It checked references mechanically and reports LLM reviewers catching numerical discrepancies as instances. We found no systematic check of printed arithmetic in it. Our own arithmetic: 111 of 253 is 43.87 %, consistent with 'approximately 44%'.
